evidence: The Alternative.me Fear & Greed Index sits at 12 ('Extreme Fear'), dropping from 14 the prior day and remaining well below both the 7-day mean (15.29) and 30-day mean (28.87). Deep, sustained readings in the extreme fear territory over seven consecutive days (ranging between 12 and 20) suggest acute market pessimism and potential oversold conditions. Historically, extreme capitulatory sentiment readings can create conditions favorable to mean-reversion relief bounces over a 24-hour window, although persistent negative momentum continues to present downside risk. Weighing the potential for a technical oversold bounce against dominant bearish sentiment yields a marginally positive probability of 0.52 for an upward close over the next 24 hours.
limitations: Fear & Greed Index is a lagging composite sentiment proxy and does not directly capture order book liquidity or intra-day spot flows.
Extreme fear states can persist longer than 24 hours during systemic sell-offs.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
